speaker: Devotee (marveling)
question: Whose drop is all bliss?
premises: Whatever bliss at all is seen here even in three worlds.
That is a drop of whom: to that god, bliss-ocean, I bow.
inference: All seen bliss is a drop of the bliss-ocean god.

speaker: Devotee (praising chanters)
question: Who are blessed?
premises: Ah, blessed Brahmā and others who dropped all other talk.
Mutter overwhelmed with joy: homage, homage to Śiva.
inference: Blessed are those chanting Śiva, dropped all else.

speaker: Devotee (bowing)
question: To whom bow — desireless enjoyer?
premises: To desireless yet ordainer of endless desires.
Even in world's beginninglessness, to enjoyer — O Bhava, let bow be to you.
inference: Bow to desireless ordainer and enjoyer.

speaker: Devotee (reasoning service)
question: Who seeks service from the perfect?
premises: We praise the lord, root-nature of three-world beginning.
Who would seek any service from him, since of perfect nature?
inference: None seeks service from the perfect-natured lord.

option_choices.reason: Causal since (perfect nature, so no service sought); ablative from-whom is same source, T1 since kept.
Nature (perfect being); duty is same dharman, T1 nature kept.

speaker: Devotee (testifying remembrance)
question: What clears deluded minds?
premises: Even in great hard straits, dirtied by delusion-flood.
When he is remembered, minds clear: that Śiva we praise.
inference: Remembrance of Śiva clears deluded minds.

option_choices.reason: They-clear (minds become lucid); gracious is same prasīd, T1 clear kept.

speaker: Devotee (asserting power)
question: Whose power unfolds worlds?
premises: O lord, from you alone here sovereign power unbroken.
By whose will the three worlds' dissolution and rise unfold.
inference: From you alone unbroken power unfolds worlds' rise and fall.

speaker: Devotee (inverting evil and good)
question: What evil becomes supreme good?
premises: Even evil deed aimed at which god would become supreme good.
Even good deed's goodness — since elsewhere you are not so, O!
inference: Evil aimed at you becomes supreme; good is good only by you.

speaker: Devotee (seizing and running)
question: Who runs to Dhūrjaṭi?
premises: 'Seized by fist you are, seen you are — where go you from us?' — thus.
Puffed with devotion-rasa, the blessed run to Dhūrjaṭi.
inference: Devotion-puffed blessed seize and chase Dhūrjaṭi.

option_choices.reason: From-us (ablative, where go from us); genitive of-us is same bond, T1 from-us kept.

speaker: Devotee (praising beyond Veda)
question: Whom praise beyond bright and beyond?
premises: We praise you — of Ṛk-Yajus-Sāman, from bright, from beyond, beyond.
Whose Veda-embodied knowable — ah, deep-lovely.
inference: Praise you beyond Veda, bright, beyond — deep-lovely knowable.
uncertainties: śukrataḥ bright vs seed — M00089 required, AMBIGUOUS retained; vedātmikājñeyam parsing open; gambhīrasundarī referent open (speech? śruti?).

option_choices.reason: From-bright kept literal; seed/semen needs M00089, AMBIGUOUS retained.
Veda-embodied-knowable kept; alternative bracketing same knowable, T1 kept.
Deep-lovely kept; profound-beautiful same compound, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (reasoning origin)
question: From where the dharma-multitude?
premises: Rule, beginning, so end you are of the world, O Supreme Lord.
The dharma-multitude set forth: which is not from you — from where would it be?
inference: You are rule, beginning, end; all dharmas are from you.

option_choices.reason: Rule (vidhi as ordinance); Brahmā-ordainer personifies same rule, T1 rule kept.
